title: CLIP-Driven Universal Model for Organ Segmentation and Tumor Detection

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《CLIP-Driven Universal Model for Organ Segmentation and Tumor Detection》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】An increasing number of public datasets have shown a marked impact on automated organ segmentation and tumor detection.

evidence.text: An increasing number of public datasets have shown a marked impact on automated organ segmentation and tumor detection.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《CLIP-Driven Universal Model for Organ Segmentation and Tumor Detection》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】To address these issues, we propose the CLIP-Driven Universal Model, which incorporates text embedding learned from Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) to segmentation models.

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】The proposed model is developed from an assembly of 14 datasets, using a total of 3,410 CT scans for training and then evaluated on 6,162 external CT scans from 3 additional datasets.

evidence.text: To address these issues, we propose the CLIP-Driven Universal Model, which incorporates text embedding learned from Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) to segmentation models.
The proposed model is developed from an assembly of 14 datasets, using a total of 3,410 CT scans for training and then evaluated on 6,162 external CT scans from 3 additional datasets.
